CONVERSATION.NAME: Make Dylan Stop His Player Ways
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Dylan stood you up at the movie theater and claims it's because he's not wired for monogamy.
LIKE-Remind Dylan just how much he likes you.
BELIEVE-Make a convincing argument why Dylan shouldn't be a player
UNSURE-Get Dylan's ego under control.

CARD.NAME: A little advice.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The less people trust you the less you trust yourself.

CARD.NAME: Grow up.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Steady relationships are a sign of maturity, they show that you know what you want and how to keep it.

CARD.NAME: I totally saw you flirting!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: At the bookstore? With that tramp in the CBGB shirt? What was up with that?

CARD.NAME: I'm the best.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Think about it, how are you going to find a girl as cool as me who also appreciates your enormous talent?

CARD.NAME: Monogamy is cool.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Do you really think you are going to get anywhere without someone by your side?

CARD.NAME: Player hater.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You think it's cool to be a player, but smart people see through that and recognize it for what it is, a cry for help.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Dylan's Rep
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Yeah, you've got a rep. And you're proud of that? Nobody likes a manwhore.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Standing up girls is Dylan's MO
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Don't play me. I know your game. You thought standing me up would make me want you more. Think again.

CARD.NAME: Search your feelings.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Why don't you take a few minutes and think about what you're doing. Deep down inside I know you're better than this.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Megan has your mix CD
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I found out Megan has the same mix CD you gave me. I thought that was a personal message to me.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Melissa has your mix CD
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I found out Melissa has the same mix CD you gave me. I thought that was a personal message to me.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Stefanie has your mix CD
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I found out Stefanie has the same mix CD you gave me. I thought that was a personal message to me.

CARD.NAME: Secret: You did the same to Megan.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Megan told me you used to check out other girls all the time when you were with her. You don't see a pattern here?

CARD.NAME: Seduction
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Make Dylan understand what he'll be missing. All your dialog that increases like is stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of like,

CARD.NAME: Sweet lies?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Remember all those sweet things you said to me? Remember how you said I was special? Were those just lies so you could get what you want?

CARD.NAME: This isn't the real you, right?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I think the real Dylan is a sweet honest guy, not this selfish monster you're pretending to be.

CARD.NAME: Two can play that game
CARD.DESCRIPTION: While I was waiting for you at the movies, I met this guy who seemed really cool.

CARD.NAME: You don't know what you're missing
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I am the best thing that ever happened to you. Why can't you realize that?

CARD.NAME: You said I was special
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You said I was special, don't you remember that? Were those just words?

CARD.NAME: You're scared.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Listen, I get it. You say you don't want a serious relationship because you need to be free, but really you are just scared of measuring up.

CARD.NAME: Born to it.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I've been a player since I first started talking, I'm not going to change now.

CARD.NAME: Commited Player
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dylan is hard to convince, he holds his "convictions" strongly. All his dialog reducing belief is stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of believe,

CARD.NAME: Don't smother me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You've got to give me my space, girl.

CARD.NAME: I'm a wild stallion
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I need to run free, babe. Don't try to fence me in.

CARD.NAME: It's only natural
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If we were supposed to be with just one person, why do I think other girls are hot?

CARD.NAME: My phone died
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I totally meant to call you and tell you I was going to be late, but my phone died!

CARD.NAME: Rumor: You're doing the same.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I heard you were scoping out all the guys in town. We're the same, you and me.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Too much love
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I've got too much love, it just seems wrong not to share it.

CARD.NAME: Set in his ways.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dylan has been a player a long time. All his cards that reduce unsure are stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: You're only young once
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What, you want to, like, get married? Come on! We're young, let's just have fun.
